        ▸ Base WCID Ranges
      

      

        

          Reserved WCID ranges for new weenies, by category. Edit the min/max to match your server's conventions.
          The folder dropdown controls where files in each range are saved — anywhere in the app, a weenie whose
          WCID falls in a range is written to that range's folder automatically.

      CUSTOMIZE
      
      
    

    
    

      Server mod required. These edits are a
      preview only. To use them in game your ACE server needs the
      CustomClothingBase mod
      (github.com/OptimShi/CustomClothingBase) —
      export drops a JSON file into its json/
      folder, then run /clear-clothing-cache.
      Without that mod the export does nothing. Players need no downloads.
